input.synthetic: Boolean true required; fabricated data only
input.records: 1..200 objects: entity_type and text required; citizen {name,address} and case_number optional. Unknown fields rejected.
input.text: 1..10000 characters; government-form feedback or policy/regulation text

shared_schema.output: One JSON object: status, schema_version, synthetic, summary, sources, deduplication, themes, review. Errors contain status=error and a plain-language message.
shared_schema.validation: One validate function for both API and CLI; strict field allowlists and types, synthetic label, size limits, no unsupported controls. CLI also rejects repeated JSON keys and nonfinite numbers.

cross_stage_handoffs: Validated records -> private-value masking and deterministic normalized deduplication -> keyword themes -> minimal supporting excerpts and review explanations. All processing stays in memory.

behavior.deduplication: Across entity types, remove declared private values and detected email/phone/SSN spans, case-fold, then compare word sequences. Keep first source and all duplicate references. Do not merge empty masked records.
behavior.themes: Deterministic whole-word rules; multiple themes may match one item. Counts use unique feedback, not all submissions. Rules and limitations are included in output.
behavior.traceability: Generated record references use input order; excerpt start/end are exact Python character offsets into original source text. Sources include entity type. No input case identifiers are exposed.
behavior.citizen_privacy: Never output full source text or private metadata. Excerpts contain only approved service-language terms outside known private spans. This is a synthetic Privacy Act/GDPR-oriented safeguard, not general PII detection or certification.
behavior.open_records_review: Reasons, rules, duplicate mappings and source offsets support human explanation without automated eligibility decisions. Original inputs must remain in controlled storage.
behavior.accessibility: Plain-language labels and explanations, structured text, no color or visual-only meaning. Demonstrates Section 508 spirit; no conformance claim.
behavior.fixture: Clearly synthetic personas, invented case numbers, non-traceable addresses, and an invented policy that explicitly is not law.

test_outcomes.suite: 14 unittest cases covering normal, deterministic, edge, invalid input, privacy, traceability and CLI behavior
test_outcomes.cli: Passed: exit 0, one valid JSON object, status ok; 4 source records, 3 unique feedback items, 1 duplicate
